newsitem.title: USA: Marathon sets Illinois refinery turnaround.
newsitem.headline: Marathon sets Illinois refinery turnaround.

text.p: Marathon Oil Co is slated to begin maintenance work that will idle a 175,000 barrel per day crude unit at its Robinson, Ill., refinery beginning on March 27, traders said.

The company also plans to conduct maintenance on a 35,000 barrel per day reformer, 24,000 barrel per day hydrotreater and 24,600 barrel per day coker in the month-long turnaround at the 175,000 barrel per day refinery, traders said.
A company spokesman declined comment on the refiner's plans. "We don't discuss normal maintenance," he said.
Marathon, a unit of USX-Marathon Group, is one of several major Midwest oil refineries conducting seasonal maintenance ahead of the summer driving season, traders said.
Mobil Corp's 188,000 barrel per day Joliet, Ill., refinery is scheduled to complete maintenance on unspecified units on March 22.
Sinclair Oil Corp's 54,000 barrel per day Tulsa, Okla., refinery comes out of a turnaround on March 25, traders said.
Farmland recently completed maintenance on a 16,000 barrel per day reformer and two hydrotreaters rated at 27,000 barrels per day capacity, traders said.
